crop.notes: Nine pieces covering General Sporting notes and many railroad items; the Allen part is only the two-line 'Tom Allen' card at the top of crop-2.

ocr.notes: Allen card read correctly apart from 'Pugil@st'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic carried a card for Tom Allen, "Retired Champion Pugilist of the World," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Saturday Morning, February 8, 1890, page 6.

facts.fact: Allen advertised himself as 'Retired Champion Pugilist of the World' at his place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with a free concert every evening

notes: Crop could be tightened to the two-line card. Article 780 is on the same page.
